# `oaap idp`

identity providers this node manages (RFC-0041 K3).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap idp {list,add,remove,check,provision,settings,export,admin-group,mail,mcp} [name] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `--all` | for 'mail': every tenant that signs in through this connector |
| `name` | the connector's short name |
| `--kind IDP_KIND_ADMIN` | which product is behind it (default keycloak) (one of `keycloak`) |
| `--url URL` | the provider's base address, e.g. https://auth.example.org |
| `--auth AUTH` | a service account (recommended) or a user login (one of `client`, `password`; default `client`) |
| `--admin-id ADMIN_ID` | the service account's client id, or a user name |
| `--admin-secret ADMIN_SECRET` | that credential's secret; kept 0600, mounted into no container at all |
| `--auth-realm AUTH_REALM` | where the credential lives (default: the product's server realm) |
| `--tenant TENANT` | for 'provision': whose space to make |
| `--space SPACE` | for 'provision': the realm name (default: the tenant's label -- it travels with the move) |
| `--client-id CLIENT_ID` | for 'provision': the client OAAP presents itself as (default: oaap-<node>) |
| `--idp-label IDP_LABEL` | for 'provision': what the button on the login page says |
| `--accept-version ACCEPT_VERSION` | state the server's version yourself -- for a credential too narrow to read it, or for a version this build was not measured against |
| `--self-registration SELF_REGISTRATION` | for 'settings': whether the space lets people register themselves (one of `on`, `off`) |
| `--second-factor SECOND_FACTOR` | for 'settings': whether the space asks for a second factor; OAAP never checks one itself (one of `off`, `required`) |
| `--reason IDP_REASON` | why a dangerous combination is wanted; goes into this tenant's log |
| `--out OUT` | for 'export': where the file goes. Absolute, outside the platform's data directory, and never over an existing file -- it carries the club's credentials (RFC-0041 K6) |
| `--instance INSTANCE` | for 'export': which instance of this product serves the connector (only needed when there is more than one); for 'mcp': the gateway instance whose clients to make |
| `--off` | for 'mcp': disable the gateway's clients (never delete them) and take the settings away |
| `--plain-callback` | for 'provision': this node is reached over plain http, so register the http callback too |
| `--dry-run` | print every call this would make, and make none |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `list` | yes |
| `add` | yes |
| `remove` | yes |
| `check` | yes |
| `provision` | yes |
| `settings` | yes |
| `export` | yes |
| `admin-group` | yes |
| `mail` | yes |
| `mcp` | yes |
